shortDescription: Module to manage power management of hosts in oVirt/RHV

options.name: address
options.description: Address of the power management interface.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: encrypt_options
options.description: If I(true) options will be encrypted when send to agent.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the host to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: options
options.description: Dictionary of additional fence agent options (including Power Management slot). Additional information about options can be found at U(https://github.com/ClusterLabs/fence-agents/blob/master/doc/FenceAgentAPI.md).

options.name: order
options.description: Integer value specifying, by default it's added at the end.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user specified in C(username) parameter.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the power management. oVirt/RHV predefined values are I(drac5), I(ipmilan), I(rsa), I(bladecenter), I(alom), I(apc), I(apc_snmp), I(eps), I(wti), I(rsb), I(cisco_ucs), I(drac7), I(hpblade), I(ilo), I(ilo2), I(ilo3), I(ilo4), I(ilo_ssh), but user can have defined custom type.

options.name: username
options.description: Username to be used to connect to power management interface.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
